about: Signals the change overview (scripts/changes.js) reads from changed paths and added lines. Path globs per specialist group come from .keel/profile.json (triggers); these add what a path cannot show. Regular expressions are case-insensitive and run on added lines only.

security.about: Added code that touches authentication, access, secrets, crypto or a classic injection sink.

money.about: Added code that handles money or balances: escalates to Maximum in files the project's security globs match (business code); elsewhere it is only listed among the signals.

deletion.about: Added code or SQL that deletes data in bulk (a DELETE without WHERE on its line, an ORM bulk delete) or drops structure: escalates to Maximum.

file_removal.about: Added code that removes folders recursively (rm -rf, rmtree, a recursive rm): calls the security group, which checks what the path can be. It deletes files, not data, so it does not escalate to Maximum.

bulk.about: Files besides the lock files of data/catalog.json whose changed lines say nothing about the size of the work: generated and vendored files. They are not counted for the level and their hunks are not shown to agents (a one-line count instead).

comments.about: Line comment markers per file extension. A changed line that is blank or starts with one of these markers does not change behavior; a marker ending in a space also matches a line that is only the marker. Extensions not listed: every changed line counts as behavior.
